title: Endometriosis, Adenomyosis and Infertility
subject: ss-reproductive-medicine
refs: ASRM Practice Committee Opinions on Endometriosis and Infertility

steps.say: Endometriosis represents a prevalent chronic disorder impairing reproductive capacity. Between thirty and fifty percent of infertile women harbor ectopic lesions. The peritoneal milieu exhibits sustained inflammatory changes.
steps.tx: Affecting roughly **30 to 50 percent** of women undergoing fertility evaluations, **endometriosis prevalence** underscores a major pathophysiological challenge. Subfertility stems from toxic peritoneal **chronic inflammation**, tubal distorted architecture from **pelvic adhesions**, and diminished follicular quality. Comprehensive clinical evaluation and disciplined reproductive management ensure optimal procedural outcomes and diagnostic precision across advanced subfertility protocols.

nodes.label: Dense pelvic adhesions and altered tubo-ovarian anatomy
Impaired gamete transport and reduced oocyte competence

steps.say: Surgical staging standardizes anatomical disease burden across clinical trials. The revised American system sums point values across four anatomical tiers. Severe disease reflects extensive pelvic obliteration.
steps.tx: The revised American Society for Reproductive Medicine classification scores disease burden into Stage I (minimal, 1-5), Stage II (mild, 6-15), Stage III (moderate, 16-40), and Stage IV (severe, >40). This **rASRM score** guides standardized **endometriosis staging** and clinical prognosis. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

steps.say: Surgical excision of ovarian endometriomas carries significant collateral risk. Stripping the cyst wall inadvertently removes healthy adjacent primordial follicles. Postoperative ovarian reserve markers show substantial declines.
steps.tx: Laparoscopic stripping during **ovarian cystectomy** inadvertently removes functional follicles, causing marked **cortex stripping**. The resulting thermal and mechanical trauma leads to an average **AMH depletion** of 30 to 40 percent, permanently compromising follicular ovarian reserve. Comprehensive clinical evaluation and disciplined reproductive management ensure optimal procedural outcomes and diagnostic precision across advanced subfertility protocols.

steps.say: Clinical guidelines urge caution before operating on endometriomas prior to assisted reproduction. Asymptomatic cysts do not diminish in vitro fertilization success. Surgery is reserved for intractable symptoms or diagnostic ambiguity.
steps.tx: Laparoscopic cystectomy for an **endometrioma 4 cm** or larger prior to IVF does not improve IVF pregnancy rates or live births. Such **pre-IVF surgery** should be avoided in asymptomatic women to achieve vital **ovarian reserve preservation** before stimulation. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

nodes.label: Assess symptoms, ultrasound features, and size
Asymptomatic / benign ultrasound: Proceed directly to IVF
Intractable pain / suspicious features: Laparoscopic surgery

steps.say: Prolonged suppression of the hypothalamic pituitary axis prior to transfer mitigates uterine inflammation. Down regulation for three to six months clears receptive defects. Clinical trials confirm improved pregnancy rates in advanced disease.
steps.tx: Pre-treatment with an **ultra-long protocol** employing **GnRH agonist pre-treatment** for **3 to 6 months** prior to fresh or frozen embryo transfer suppresses inflammatory mediators, enhancing clinical pregnancy and live birth rates in patients with severe endometriosis or **adenomyosis**. Comprehensive clinical evaluation and disciplined reproductive management ensure optimal procedural outcomes and diagnostic precision across advanced subfertility protocols.

rows: Profound hypoestrogenism; clears IL-6 and TNF
Direct suppression of local intra-lesional E2

steps.say: Adenomyosis represents ectopic invasion within the myometrial wall. Imaging demonstrates diagnostic structural irregularities along the inner margin. Expansion of the junctional zone impairs deep vascular remodeling.
steps.tx: Diagnostic criteria for **adenomyosis criteria** feature asymmetrical myometrial thickening, **subendometrial microcysts**, and a **junctional zone** maximum thickness exceeding **12 mm** on high-resolution transvaginal ultrasound or MRI, correlating with increased miscarriage risks. Comprehensive clinical evaluation and disciplined reproductive management ensure optimal procedural outcomes and diagnostic precision across advanced subfertility protocols.

steps.say: Postoperative fecundity prediction requires validated clinical staging calculators. The Endometriosis Fertility Index combines historical factors with surgical scores. It accurately predicts spontaneous pregnancy probabilities.
steps.tx: The **Endometriosis Fertility Index** generates an **EFI score** from 0 to 10 by integrating historical patient factors (age, duration of infertility, pregnancy history) with surgical scores, reliably predicting the probability of **spontaneous conception** over **36 months** post-laparoscopy. Comprehensive clinical evaluation and disciplined reproductive management ensure optimal procedural outcomes and diagnostic precision across advanced subfertility protocols.

steps.say: Infiltrating disease involving retroperitoneal spaces demands careful therapeutic prioritization. Extensive resections carry significant surgical morbidity. In vitro fertilization takes precedence when subfertility dominates.
steps.tx: Patients with **deep infiltrating endometriosis** (DIE) involving bowel or bladder require **multidisciplinary surgery** for intractable pain. However, **IVF prioritization** is preferred over extensive surgical excision when infertility is the primary indication without acute obstruction. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

nodes.label: Severe pain / organ obstruction: Multidisciplinary excision
Infertility primary: Upfront IVF prior to extensive pelvic surgery
